description: This Java source file defines the class PurgeableBitmapView, a custom Android View that demonstrates the use of purgeable Bitmaps by decoding and displaying a bitmap repeatedly, with logic to handle memory errors.

classes.name: PurgeableBitmapView
classes.description: A custom View that demonstrates the behavior of purgeable Bitmaps, decoding bitstreams into Bitmaps and rendering them on the canvas.

methods.name: PurgeableBitmapView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view, setting whether Bitmaps are purgeable, creating a color array and encoding it into a bitstream.

methods.name: createColors
methods.description: Generates an array of colors to be used as bitmap pixel data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Decodes the bitmap from the encoded bitstream, handles memory errors, and updates the bitmap to be displayed.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overridden method to draw the current bitmap and a count of decoded Bitmaps onto the canvas.

methods.name: generateBitstream
methods.description: Compresses a Bitmap into a byte array using the specified format and quality.
